changes.evidence: Geoffrey is not part of Wizard in seasons 1–2 (it is the Minorus' company). In Runaways S3, after Catherine's death, he joins Wizard Computers under Morgan le Fay's spell (S3 episodes 6–7, 'RW306'/'RW307'), works against the Runaways, is freed after Dagger knocks him out (episode 8, RW308), and then reassembles PRIDE to rescue Molly (episode 9). Fandom lists Wizard as a former affiliation, joined in S3.

owner_calls.question: T:pr-st-pride (PRIDE) is a group record, not one person, but it is linked as the 'twin' of six people (Catherine, Geoffrey, Janet, Leslie, Robert, Tina). Should a collective group file be anyone's twin?
options: Keep the collective PRIDE file linked as each member's twin
Unlink it: treat PRIDE as a group-only record with no person twin
owner_calls.evidence: The PRIDE file describes the parents as a group in Runaways S1–S3. It does not stand for any single member.
